title: A part opened at another location after a rename shows the new number
custom_preconds: Part X stocked at A and B. Inventory open at B in tab 2.
custom_steps:
1. Tab 1 at A: rename X to X-NEW
  2. Tab 2 at B (no reload): open X
  3. Change Sell Price only and Save
custom_expected:
1. Saved
  2. Dialog shows X-NEW
